tei:div.tei:p: sa char bkod pa/ byams pa'i chos skor yan lag dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun bla ma dam pa dang 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes yod pa/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun mi g.yo ba zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod cing phyag bzhi pa 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa mgor

| gang gi drin gyis bde 'gro'i 'byor pa dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs stong mchod dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das ma zhes yod pa/ gdugs dkar bsgom thabs gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spy-i bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ ri khrod lo ma can sgrub thabs gzungs chog dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ ri khrod ma'i sgrub thabs chos rje sa skya pa'i man ngag yi ger bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /zhes yod pa/ tsun+da'i sgrub thabs rgyud las byung ba'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ srung ba lnga'i dbang chog gi skor gtor ma/ byur bsal | dug dbyung | dbang chog gi sdom/ dbang bskur ba dngos te de rnams rgyas pa 'og glegs bam ba~X pa'i nang na bzhugs kyang 'di nyid kyi sngags rnams la 'dra min mang po byung ba phyi mo mang po la gtugs nas zhus dag nan cher byas tshe 'di ltar byung la/ 'og ma ni bka' dang bstun pa'i zhu dag bgyis pa yin pas gang dag dpyad par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i bkra shis dang*/ zhar byung rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa gsung rab gsal ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'phags pa'i dngos slob shes rab gzhon nus mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gsum pa/ ( ba ) pa la 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs tshigs bcad ma mgor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa'i mgor lha mo 'od zer can sgrub pa'i thabs rjai btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal loX/

/phrin las 'od kyis zhes yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bstod pa bcas mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma 'od zer can sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ 'di skad gnyis smra ba du lag gi ngor mdzad pa'o/ /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod cing 'di dang gong gi sgrub thabs gnyis lo tsā ba saṃ gha'i don du mdzad pa yin/ de'i bstod pa rgyas pa mgor bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma'i bstod pa zhes yod pa/ spyan ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs mgor rje btsun ma gza' thams cad kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ zhar la sngags kyi dag byed cig kyang ma dpe na byung ba bzhin bris yod/ 'dod pa'i lha rnams la bstod pa mgor/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /zhes yod pa/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i tshig tshan pa gnyis kyi mgor na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā rā ya/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang ma/ /zhes yod pa dang*/ na mo badz+ra satwā ya/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por che brjod dang mchod gar gsungs pa de yin/ srung ba lnga'i sdom ring thung gnyis kyi mgor/ rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ /zhes dang rje btsun ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba zhes yod pa/ de'i mtshams gcod mgor gnas dang yo byad byin phab nas zhes yod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa | de'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa mgor gong gi tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bstod pa mgor srung ba lnga'i lha mo la bstod pa zhes yod pa/ yang de'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa mgor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa zhes yod pa/

'di slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa la 'phags pas kha skong mdzad gsung | phyogs kyi gtor ma mgor de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtang ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ gza' skar gyi gtor ma mgor gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces yod pa/ byur bsal ba de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ dug dbyung ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ rgyal bar byed pa mgor na mo bud+dha ya zhes yod pa/ dbang bskur ba dngos mgor de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇ+ḍal phul la zhes yod pa/ 'di yan dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kar gza' skar gyi gtor ma sogs gsungs pas sogs khangs su bsdus par nges shing phyi mo mang po na yang dpe tshan gcig tu byas 'dug dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma mgor tad+ya thā oṃ gi ri gi ri zhes yod pa/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa mgor bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis zhes yod pa/ shis pa brjod pas mgor nad pa'i zas dang skom dang zhes yod pa ste 'di gnyis gong ma'i khar sa bcad bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa 'grigs kyang dpe rgyun gcig las ma byung bas dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na thus min slar dpyad/ rgyud sde'i dkar chag mgor na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥ shrī bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka badz+ra ngha rā ya zhes yod pa/ mgon po'i sgrub yig mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo | | dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes yod pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa mgor na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn maḥ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ hūm̐ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bstod pa gnyis gsungs kyang 'di las ma byung bas yig skyon yin nam brtag

lcam dral gyi gtor chog mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang zhes yod pa jim gyim la phul ba gsungs pa 'di yin/ bshags pa mgor dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral zhes yod pa/ gdong bzhi ba'i bstod pa mgor dpal gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa zhes yod pa/ dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'phags pa dzam+bha la bsgom par zhes yod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma mgor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs su lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma zhes pa nas byang phyogs su bya ba gnod sbyin thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can sa skya pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la zhes yod pa/ cha gsum gtor ma 'bring po mgor bgegs gtor ni/ bsang ba nas zhes yod pa/ klu gtor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu gtor gtang bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ chu gtor gtang ba'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang zhes yod pa/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan ngag rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya dang tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por chos rje sa paṇa la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba mthong tshe bstod pa yin/ 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /zhes yod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu lnga yod | 'jam dpal la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba mgor na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya shes bya kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes yod pa/

'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba mgor na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs/ /zhes yod pa/ phyag mtshan ri mo'i bstod tshig la spel ba mgor 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bde gshegs thub pas sa gsum snyan par bsgrags/ /zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo la bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub pas/ /zhes yod pa/ phyag 'tshal du phyin pa'i tshe ri bo rtse lnga'i rigs so so dang mthun par bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byams pa'i lte ba rab tu brtan zhing zhes yod pa/ ā nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo dris pa mgor pañtsa sarba ta bi kri ḍā zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal la bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam pa sna tshogs lo 'dab kyis bkra zhes yod pa/ skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti la mnal lam du bstod pa mgor na maḥ shrī lo ke shwa rā ya 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po zhes yod pa/ byams pa mgon po la bstod pa mgor/ byams pa'i thugs kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ / zhes yod pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug bstod pa mgor/ dgra bcom blo mchog dbang dul ba/ /zhes yod pa/ yan lag bcu pa mgor dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /zhes yod pa/ yan lag bdun pa phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad mgor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /zhes yod pa/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i zhes yod pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa 'bring du bstan pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /spy-ir bstan pa'i gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhes yod pa/ yang de gsum bsdus pa yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang gi don du mdzad pa/

skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bo lod kyi don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi bslab bya rgyal po a rog che la phul ba/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bsdus don mgor mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhes yod pa/ theg pa chen po gsal ba zhes bya ba yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bsdus don mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ theg pa chen po gsal ba la don gsum zhes yod pa/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu pa mgor ming de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu maṅga la la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'-i rab tu byed pa tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal po ho ko'i don du mdzad pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi rnam gzhag mgor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rgyal po ho ka'i don du zhes yod pa/ /rgyal bu de gus bho ga la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu de mur bho ga la gdams pa zla ba'i 'od zer mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpon mo pun+da ri'i don du mdzad pa sgrub pa'i rim pa rab tu gsal ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo | | bdag la phyi dang nang gi zhes yod pa/ rgyal sras jim gyim la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas zhes yod pa/ yang jim gyim la spring ba gnyis kyi mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen te | | zhes pa dang*/ brtse ba'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa zhes yod pa/

/a tsa ra la spṛng ba mgor/ mi gang dal ba 'byor pa thob gyur cing*/ /zhes yod pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ldong ston gyi don du spring ba'i yi ge mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'byung na/ /zhes yod pa/ ye shes 'bum la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i thig le mgor bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa/ rigs par smra ba grags bzang la spring ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bden pa gnyis rnam par nges pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid/ /ces yod pa/ de'i khrid yan lag bdun ldan mgor phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i man ngag yan lag bdun pa zhes yod pa/ yan lag bdun gyi gtam mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dam chos pad dkar gyi tshig don la gzhan gyi log pa rtog pa dgag pa mgor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las byung ba'i gsung rab kyi zhes yod pa/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa mgor theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes yod pa/ snying po'i sdom/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sdom/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sdom/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i sdom/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sdom ste zab mo'i mdo lngar grags pa'i sdom rnams kyi mgor so so'i tshig de rnams yod pa/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi bsdus don mgor/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ skyo ba'i gtam mgor na mo gu ru mañdzu nā thā ya/ thugs kyi bang mdzod yon tan nor bus gtams/ /zhes yod pa/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel ba'i gtam mgor 'dir smras pa/

snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snyigs ma'i ngang tshul can/ /zhes yod pa/ theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bsam gtan shes rab kyi dris lan mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can | | zhes yod pa/ ka sogs sum cu la spel ba'i tshigs bcad mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ ka la piṅka'i dbyangs ltar snyan gsung gis/ /zhes yod pa/ ldan yul du skyes pa'i ston pa brtson 'grus kyi dris lan mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dris pa'i lan cung zad gdab par bya ste zhes yod pa/ byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dran pa gso thabs mgor/ gang gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por lta ba ston pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs pa 'di 'dra/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge tshogs dpag med rin chen las bsgrubs shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ tsha rong ba la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing | | zhes yod pa/ sdom brtson zhig la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs shing

| | zhes yod pa/ zab mo nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu 'chi ba bsam par bya/ /zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /zhes yod pa/ yang de la spring ba mgor/ ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ yi gyang jus glegs bam bsgrubs pa la bsngags pa mgor/ na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya | dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te/ /zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag pa med dbyings nam mkha'i khams/ /zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu algo la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs pa/ /zhes yod pa/ rin chen pak+ṣi la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /zhes yod pa/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mī ka ra la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong blo gros kyi ming dang ldan pa zhes yod pa/ shong ston lo tsā ba la spring ba bla ma 'phags pas zhes yod pa/ rwa dbon la spring ba mgor/ gzhung lugs brgya phrag du ma'i chu klung dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa ral gri la spring ba mgor/ mkha' dbyings dag pa skye rgu'i sgron me'i dpal/ /zhes yod pa/ spyi 'u lhas pa bshes gnyen rin chen la bskur ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas nyer zhi zhi ba'i lam gyis zhes yod pa/ chag lo tsā ba | dbus gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spy-i/ dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spy-i/ stag lung ba/ dbus kyi sgom chen pa spyi rnams la rim pa bzhin du ma chags lo bdag ces pa dang*/ dmigs med thugs rje'i zhes pa dang*/ ji bzhin gzigs pas zhes pa dang*/

srid dang zhi ba'i zhes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang zhes pa rnams kyi dbu can/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba gsum gi mgor ye shes dkyil 'khor zhes pa dang*/ spros pa med pa'i zhes pa dang*/ mtshan dpe'i dpal zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ dpon mo du gal dur mi la bskur ba gnyis kyi mgor dpal ldan yon tan zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu jim gyim/ ho ko grags bzang*/ ston gzhon rnams la spring ba'i mgor 'dir smras pa/ deng sang 'di na zhes pa dang*/ stobs sogs yon tan zhes pa dang | mdangs dang dri ro zhes pa dang*/ blo che rlom che zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang bsngo ba mgor/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' las mngon 'phags shing | | zhes yod pa/ tshe dpag med la bstod pa mgor/ sna tshogs 'dab rgyas chu skyes zhes bya ba yod pa'i sh+lo ka gcig yang 'di la ma dmigs zhes pa dang*/ yan lag drug cus zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'thor bu gnyis/ mgon g.yag la bsngags pa mgor/ gang lus char sprin phung po ni/ /zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por glang po che la bsngags pa gsungs pa 'di nyid la yig skyon zhugs pa 'dra/ chang la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgor khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*/ /zhes yod pa/ mchod 'os la bsngags pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs zhes yod pa | lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi rin po che'i 'od zer dri ma med pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso/ /zhes yod pa/ nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa mgor | gsal zhing thogs med myur du 'jug /ces yod pa/

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron me mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ de'i don yang dag par bsdus pa mgor dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab byung sogs bsdoms bcu gnyis zhes yod pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od rab gsal zhing*/ /zhes yod pa/ dh+rū ba gnyis pa'i rtsis mgor/ na mo gu ru rat+na bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā ya/ gang gi thugs rjes 'gro kun rab bzung nas/ /zhes yod pa/ lo bdag nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsis mgor/ mkhyen pas shes bya kun gzigs nas/ /zhes yod pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid rin po che'i sgron ma mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ chos 'khor dus kyi bstan rtsis mgor sangs rgyas bltams pa'i dus la sogs nas zhes yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi'i ngos 'dzin mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan nas zhes yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs bzhengs pa po jim gyim yin/ pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dam pa'i chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por jim gyim gsungs pa 'di yin/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kar gnyis yod gsungs kyang gcig las dpe ma rnyed/ maṅga la yab yum gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang phal po che bzhengs pa la bsngags pa mgor chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes yod pa/

ji big de mur gyis phal po che/ gser 'od dam pa/ stong phrag brgya pa rnams bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i thugs n-i kun nas rnam dag cing*/ /zhes yod pa dang*/ rgyal po a rog ches 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi'i bde legs ma lus 'byung ba'-i gzhi/ /zhes yod pa/ go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor gsung rab rin po che rnam par dkod pa'i mtshon byed ces yod pa/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyi yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la spy-i bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa la bsngags pa mgor chos bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed nye bar bkod pa zhes yod pa/ zin shing gi ston pa bcu bdun yang dag pa'i rigs pas pham par byas te rab tu byung ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yod dang med pa la sogs pa/ /zhes yod pa/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dang slob mas lam nyams su blang ba'i tshul gyi rnam dbye bstan pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsang mkhas rab brtan byams par ldan/ /zhes yod pa/ chos rje bde bar gshegs dus dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba mgor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /zhes yod pa/ khro phu lo tsā ba la bskur ba dang gdams pa gnyis mgor/ dpal ldan nyin mor byed pa'i gzi ldan zhing | | zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer gyis/ / zhes yod pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun rnams zhes yod pa/

bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshul ni zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po 'di gsal kha med kyang phyi mo thams cad na gong gi las chog dang 'brel nas 'dug pas lung rgyun yod pa 'dra/ rgyal po yab sras kyis mchod rten bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor daṇ+ḍa ka mgor na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ dpal dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rgyal bu jim gyim sogs la bsngags pa gsung pa 'di yin/ bsngags par 'os pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa rgyal po go pe la la bsngags par gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad mgor gang gi srid gsum rgya mtsho'i zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por jim gyim la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ srong btsan sgom po me mo glang la 'khrungs/ /zhes yod pa/ lung dang brgyud pa sna tshogs kyi gsan yig mgor/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang zhes yod pa/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge'i spyan sngar 'phrin du zhu ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes yod pa/ grags pa rin chen gyi zhus lan mgor dpal mchog bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis/ /zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong la bka' sgo gnang ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang zhes yod pa/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma kho na mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong zhes yod pa/ rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas pa la bde legs su bya ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/

shing yos dpal ldan ma/ me 'brug bsod nams ma/ me sbrul dpal 'byung ma/ sa rta bkra shis ma | 'dir lug sprel gnyis la mi snang*/ lcags bya tshe dang ye shes ma/ chu khyi 'gro ba ma/ chu phag bde legs ma/ shing by-i gang mnyes ma/ shing glang byang sems ma/ me stag he ru ka dpal ma/ me yos rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ sa 'brug ji snyed ma*/ sa sbrul rgyal ba ma/ lcags rta bkra shis ma/ lcags lug chos nyid ma/ chu sprel skyob pa ma | chu bya dngos grub ma/ shing khyi sa dbang ma/ shing phag bla med ma/ me byi dngos grub ma/ me glang don grub ma/ sa stag gang la bkra shis ma/ sa yos gang drin ma/ lcags 'brug thub dbang chos rgyal ma rnams te lo gsar gyi tshe gnang ba'i bkra shis nyer gsum ma/ /yang dpal ldan khyed sku lhun po ltar brtan zhing | | zhes bya ba'i bkra shis sh+lo ka gcig rnams bzhugs so// //'di dag gi go rim bsgrigs pa'i gzhi ni ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho dang*/ glo bo smon thang gi rgyal pos gong ma yab sras gsum gyi bka' 'bum bzhengs pa'i dkar chag rdau rje 'chang gis mdzad pa dang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed dang*/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po rnams la zhib tu gtugs tshe/ snga phyi'i go rim 'dra min dang chos tshan mang nyung sogs kyi khyad par 'ga' re mchis kyang*/ 'dir sngon gyi bka' 'bum phal cher dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dang mthun shas che ba byung bas 'ga' zhig de nyid gzhir bzhag da lta'i lung rgyun dpal mchog nas sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan pa 'di nyid khyab che ba snang yang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i de dang snga phyi'i go rim dang chos tshan mang nyung dang*/ bstan bcos kyi ming bzung yang 'ga' zhig gzhung tshig dang*/ 'ga' zhig kha byang las dras nas btags pa sogs kyis las dang po pas ngos zin dka' bar 'dug kyang*/

'dir gong 'og thams cad kyi khyad par ngos gzung sla ba'i ched du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas sgo khyim la aṃ gi dgu pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa dgu la dkon mchog lhun grub pas gsan ltar rtogs pa dang*/ aṃ gi nyer bzhi pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas gdan sa nyer bzhi pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan ltar rtogs par 'gyur la | gzhan paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub | ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gsan pa'i lung rgyun ni brgyud pa'i kha skong ma gtogs pa yan chad dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig ji lta ba bzhin yin no/ /rtags gang yang med pa rnams ni gsan yig na med kyang*/ glegs bam gyi gras su sngar yod pa dang phyis rnyed pa gsar 'dzud zhus pa rnams yin pas/ slar 'di dag gi lung rgyun brgyud pa yid ches pa las btsal te rgya cher spel dgos so zhes pa'i don yin no | | smas pa/ rgyas bshad dkar chag ngos su phra zhib chos/ /gtan la 'bebs nus rig pa bdag med rdzun/ /yang na shes rab rang rtsal ma 'gags gdangs// shes bya'i gnas la chags bral tsam zhig nges/ /gsung rab dad pa'i me lces yid kyi chu/ /bskol ba'i shugs kyis ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs/ /'dus pa'i dba' rlabs lang ling 'phyur ba'i rtser/ /dka' gnas lbu dkar 'dzum pa'i ltad mo byung*/ /'di mthong rgyus med mgo bo 'khor byed pa'i/ /rmongs pa skyengs te ma bzod 'dris che ba'i/ /grogs 'dis da nas bdag cag spangs so zhes/ / skyo ba'i zol gyis yul gzhan 'khyams pa bzhin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa brgyud pa'i ngos gzung gi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba la gnyis kyi dang po gong ma yab sras gsum po'i gsung rab rnams kyi lung dang glegs bam dang po nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ma byung ba la/

dus phyis bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i bkas bskul te/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje dang*/ dbus pa rin rgyal gnyis phyogs kun tu btang ste/ lung su yod las zhus shing dpe rnams phyogs gcig bsdebs pas na/ lung thams cad phyogs gcig nas brgyud pa med mod/ 'on kyang mkhan po shes rab rdo rjes bla ma so so las gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni lam 'bras sogs lam skor dgu/ lam gces bsdus dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni rje sa chen/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des sher rdor la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o/ /yang na chos rje sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan seng ge de gnyis las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gsan no/ /'on kyang gsung ngag rin po che'i skor rnams nyams khrid ma gtogs/ bklag lung byed pa'i srol med do zhes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan yig rgya mtsho las gsungs/ rgyud sde spy-i'i stong thun/ dag ldan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing*/ gur gyi sa bcad/ gur rgyan rnams sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bla ma dam pa/ sher rdor ro/ /nag po pa'i dkyil chog de'i ṭī ka nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ me trī mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs

| rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra phab pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub pa/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ me trī mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang rnams brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ sher rdor ro/ /sgrol ma spyi sgrub | so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs/ nyi sbas pas mdzad pa'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas pa'i ṭī ka sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog rnams rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa/ sher rdor ro/ /sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyi sbas/ ti lo/ nā ro/ nag po pa/ gu ru ba lo tsā ba/ rong pa/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ bla ma sa chen/ mchims khu dbon gnyis/ bla ma 'jam gsar/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma rga lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa man chad gong dang 'dra/ dkyil chog gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ dā na shrī/ mañdzu shrī mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen pa/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ bla ma 'jam gsar/ sri'u/ rje btsun rga lo/ sher seng*/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa man chad sngar dang 'dra/ sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi ma'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ grub pa dpal bzang po/ bla ma bzang po pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man gong dang 'dra | rnam 'joms byab bsrung dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa man 'dra'o/ /sa chen pa'i rgyud sde spy-i'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ ṭī ka bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'brel/ sa bcad/ mal lo'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i ṭī ka che ba/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka che ba rnams bla ma sa chen/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ sher rdor ro/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i saṃ pu ṭa'i ṭī ka

rje btsun pa'i rab gnas don gsal/ he ru ka'i chas drug gtor ma brgya rtsa rnams bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan pa/ sher rdor ro/ /sgrol ma zhi khro'i sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sher 'byung*/ ye shes 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor ro/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i mi g.yo ba'i chu bsrung ni/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje pa/ mdo sde dpal/ lo mchog bag ston/ sher rdor ro/ /kur kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'u yug pa bsod seng*/ sru lung pa kun smon/ la ru pa yon tan dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston/ sher rdor ro/ /gnyan gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa ni/ rje btsun chen po/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sku mched/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bag ston man 'dra'o/ / dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ byang chen pa/ bag ston man 'dra'o/ /ma rgyud kye'i rdo rje'i sbyor drug yang*/ gzhon tshul man chad 'dra'o/ /rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje khu dbon/ sru lung pa kun smon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ slob dpon rin chen dpal/ bla ma rgyal ba dpal/ bla ma thogs med pa/ sher rdor ro/ /don zhags kyi lo rgyus/ sa bcad rgyu chung gi ṭī ka lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams rje btsun pa/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ gtsang so zho ra ba/ la ru pa/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen dwangs ma ba/ sher rdor ro/ /dril bu pa'i dbang chu/ sgrub thabs gnyis/ paṇa chen pa man gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ des bo dong rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen rin chen grub/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa man sngar bzhin no/ /sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭi ka mtshan brjod 'don thabs rnams rje btsun sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/

/bde ba dpal bka' bzhi grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ sher rdor ro/ /kye'i rdo rje'i dbang chu chen mo/ dbang mchog nas gling ma/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa dang*/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs gsum/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs/ las bcu/ mchims chos seng la spring yigagazhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen rnams paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ 'jam rgyal/ bla ma a mo gha/ sher rdor ro/ /dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ rim lnga/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bri thabs rnams stod lo slob dpon a mo gha/ sher rdor ro/ /sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ ṭī ka nyi ma sbas pa'i nyer gcig ma'i las tshogs dang sa gcod rnams rje btsun pa/ bla ma thub pa mgon/ a mo gha/ sher rdor ro/ /rigs gsum spyi'i rigs gtad/ a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rnams kyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ shong pa bsod rin/ slob dpon gzungs 'dus/ rin po che bsod nams dbang phyug sher rdor ro/ /brtag gnyis kyi ṭī ka rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ chos rje khu dbon/ de gnyis ka las shong ba bsod rin/ sras kun rin/ sher rdor ro/ /rab gnas bzang po drug dus tha ma'i cho ga bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka kye rdor dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams 'phags pa rin po che | cog ro ston gzhon/ chos brtson/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro/ / 'dod rgyal dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa'i ṭī ka sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen/ khums pa dbon po/ rje btsun rga lo/ ā ka ra/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro/ /tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs che chung*/ rje btsun pa | paṇa chen pa/ skyob pa dpal/

gzhon nu bkra shis/ rdo rje dpal/ gu rub sher rin/ sangs rgyas rin chen man 'dra'o/ /kye'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa chos rje bsod rgyal/ sher rdor ro/ /glu'i bshad pa la sogs pa mngon rtogs/ bstod pa la sogs pa drug cu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa/ sa chen pa yab sras gsum/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ dmar chos rgyal/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge sher rdor ro/ /gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ klu sgrub nas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyen lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ rin chen grags tshul ba/ de las mkhan po shes rab rdo rjes zhus so/ /de nas mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams | thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis | mtshungs med nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rin po che dpal mchog rgyal mtshan | de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs la'o/ /yang na yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng gedakon mchog lhun grub/ shar pa man 'dra | yang na dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra'o// //gnyis pa chos rje khu dbon gnyis las/ dang po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal | brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/

slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ chos rje byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan | paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs la'o/ /yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o/ /yang na dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// //gnyis pa 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ chos rje byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ yang na dkon lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o | | yang bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che | dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o/ /yang na dkon mchog 'phel | rje lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// //smras pa/ skal dman lha min myang khom ma byung ba'i/ /bka' srol bdud rtsis mkhas mang sngon gyi lhas/

/blangs te bshad sgrub snyim pas spel ba'i rgyun | | de 'dzin lha rnams thar pa'i bcud ldan 'gyur/ /yid la thar pa 'dod kyang thob byed chos/ /ma shes zog po'i ngag sgros bsgugs pa'i tshe/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug bstan pa'i lam 'di dang*/ /ston byed bla ma phrad rnams a re 'tsheng | | tshe 'di'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu zhig /dbul pos rnyed la dga' spro byed na deng*/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i thabs/ / 'di la dga' dang gus pa sus mi byed/ /dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i par gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos ngos gzung ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //spyi don gsum pa bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du chos sbyin par du bsgrub tshul la gsum ste/ par du bskul ba'i gang zag par du sgrub pa'i sbyin bdagasgrub pa'i grogs dang gnas dus so/ /dang po ni/ de ltar dpal sa skya'i rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam pa lnga'i gsung rab rin po che 'di rnams ni/ / dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs | mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi dgongs don ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ log par rtog pa'i grub mtha' ngan pa'i ri bo rnam par 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ blo dang ldan pa rnams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu sgrol bar byed pa'i ded dpon/ mi gnas mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma dang*/ dpal ldan bi rū pa la sogs pa grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i thugs bcud/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis pad+ma'i dri la bung ba 'khor ba bzhin du bsrungs pa'i zab chos 'di rnams/ shin tu gnyen pas mang du spel ba lta zhog

snod dang mi ldan pa rnams dam du sba zhing gsang dgos pa yin na'ang*/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde zab mo dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams nyan pa dang bshad pa dang sgom pas nyams su len pa la sogs pa'i tshe na/ lung dang rigs pa dang rjes su gdams pa ste/ mtshan nyid gsum mam gnyis gang rung dang ldan pa dang*/ de rnams kyi nang nas kyang yid ches pa'i lung dang brgyud pa khungs thub las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gtso che ste/ shin tu lkaug gyur la spyod pa la lung nyid tshad ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ lung don man ngag rgyud pa'i ngag 'gros kyis ma brgyan na/ lam gang la'ang bde bar nyams su mi len pa du ma yod pa'i phyir dang*/ lung tshig la yang ji bzhin min pa sogs la sgra ji bzhin pa sogs su mngon par zhen nas 'khrul pa'ang mang po yod de/ zla grags kyis/ mtha' drug bral bas nges par rtogs zhes gang smras pa/ /zla ba lta 'dod sor mo'i rtse la blta dang mtshungs/ / zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bas na rgyal ba'i dgongs don mtha' drug tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i don gtan la phab ste/ gsal bar ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di lta bu la yun ring du sbyangs shing khong du chud par ma byas na/ gang zag phal cher gyis 'bad pa don du mi 'gyur ba'ang mang du yod pas na de dag la phan pa'i phyir dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i slob grwa'i skye bo blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba rnams kyang mdo smad kyi phyogs 'dir bka' 'bum gyi dpe gras dkon pa'i dbang gis nyan bshad kyi rgyun dang*/ klog 'dzin byed pa'i srol sogs nyag phrar song ba de dag la'ang phan pa'i phyir dang*/ deng gi dus kyi 'gro ba skal ba dman pa rnams ni bstan pa rnam dag gi rjes su 'jug pa ches dkon zhing*/ zhugs par rlom pa rnams kyang sde snod dang rgyud sde dang de dag gi dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams tshig gi na ya tsam yin par bsams nas rna bas thos pa tsam yang don du mi gnyer bar/

de dag gi dgongs pa mi shes pa'i gang zag spy-i brtol can rnams kyis lung rigs gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i rang bzo'i tshig gang dran smras pa'i rjes su 'jug cing*/ nyan bshad sgom gsum yang de lta bu la byed pa mang zhing*/ rmongs dad can gyi snying med rnams kyang smig rgyu'i chu la ri dwags sred pa ltar de dag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'jig rten rmongs pa de dag dngos dang brgyud nas mi bslu nges pa'i lam yang dag pa dang phrad par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bcos ma ma yin pa'i lhag bsam dkar pos rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab chen po | ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i gdugs dkar gyi grib mar/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i ngal bso'i gnas su gyur pa/ gong de'i rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las dkar po'i khur gyis rnam par lci ba'i gdan sa sum cu pa/ dge slong bkraX shiXs lhunaX grubaX ces 'bod pa'i ngag nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab 'di rnams zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gzhung mang po la sbyang ba dang*/ lam yang dag pa don du gnyer ba rnams la med thabs med pa'i chos yin pas/ par du bsgrubs na legs tshul gyi bskul ba'-i tshig 'ga' thal lo/ /smras pa/ dad pa g.yon can grogs kyis don med btang*/ /chos dang chos min dpyod pa'i blo nus bral

| | gti mug chad stong mtha' las grol dus med/ /rmongs chen skye bo skal med snying re rje/ /de tshe bkraX shisaX dge 'byung e waṃ pa'i/ /lhunaX grubaX rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las kyi/ /rjes 'jug bdag gis bstan dang lus can la/ / phan re'i lhag bsam tshig gis 'di skad bskul/ /dgos don zab rgyas 'jam dbyangs rnam lnga'i gsung*/ /par du bskrun na dga' ba'i zhu gsol gdangs/ / rab snyan 'ga' zhig sa spyod mchog gi yid/ /'phrog 'dod mgrin par yibs te gnas pa bzhin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa par du sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag ni/ sngon du 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang se chen gan mchod yon nas bzung*/ da lta'i gong ma chen po 'di nyid bcas kyi las lung gi bka' tham chen mo rnams sngon gyi yab mes stong dpon zla ba bzang po nas bzung ste chos rgyal chen po 'di nyid kyi bar du rim pas phebs shing | sde bzhi dang dge bcu'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas mngon par mtho ba'i chab srid tha gru yangs po la dbang sgyur ba'i gdan sa pa/ chos dang srid kyi mkhyen dpyod mda' gzhu'i 'phrul 'khor bskyod pa tsam gyi/ chos min spyod pa dang chab srid la rnam par 'tshe ba'i phyogs kyi dgra sde mgrin pa bcu pa'i mgo bo bregs te/ bod chen yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi yid 'phrogs si tā/ dpal 'byor mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ las dbang stobs kyi grogs po ha nu man+tha'i rtsal gyi blangs te/ rang dbang du sgyur ba'i chos rgyal dga' byed chen po ste | mtshan dngos bstaXn paX tsheX riXng zhes yul gru chen po kun nas yongs su grags pa/ gong de'i zhabs stegs nor bu brtsegs pa'i ba gam mthon por rin chen gdub sil mdzes pa'i zhabs zung rnam par 'god tshe/ bod chen ljongs kyi rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa phal mo che'i gtsug gis gus pas 'dud kyang khengs pa mi mnga' zhing*/

thugs rgyud byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la 'byongs pas sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse zhing*/ khyad par mgon med dang phongs pa dang nad pa sogs ni gang la gang 'os kyi dngos pos bskyang ba dang*/ 'chi nges pa'i sems can mang po'i srog bsrung ba sogs dge ba bcu dang rjes su mthun pa'i bka' khrims kyis mnga' 'bangs thams cad rdzogs ldan dus kyi bde skyid sar pa'i dga' ston la 'god cing*/ bstan pa spy-i dang bye brag rje sa skya pa dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa'i snying stobs gzhan las khyad par 'phags shing*/ slar yang de nyid rnam par dkar ba'i bgyi ba gsum gyi sgo nas zhing 'dis gtsos pa'i yul phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i ched dang*/ rang nyid kyi'ang bla'i mchod gnas kyi ched du dmigs te/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan la sogs pa'i gdan sa chen po rnams na bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams spyan drangs te/ don yod rnam pa bzhis mnyes par mdzad cing*/ de dag las 'ongs pa'i thugs bcud rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo'i bsgom bzlas kyis nyin mtshan khor yug 'da' ba dang*/ bka' 'gyur ro cog bai ḍūr+ya'i mthing shun la rin po ches tshar mang du bzhengs shing*/ slar yang chos sbyin par du bsgrubs pas gtsos pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad bskrun pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad spyod gtam du glengs na 'jig rten mes po yang ngal snyam byed pa kho na yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i chos rgyal chen po de nyid kyi snyan dbang rin po che par du bsgrub pa'i zhu gsol phul lo/ /de nyid gsan pa'i mod la thugs dges pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas te/ bzhed don ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrub bo zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' gsal snyan pos gan+dha rba'i gling bu'i khengs pa yang

'phrog snyam byed par gyur to/ /smras pa/ de thos sa skyong bzhin las sngon med 'dzum | | bstaXn te bzhed don bsgrub paXr zhal bzhes tsheX/ /riXng gnas mkhas mang rnam shes rna ba'i sgor/ /dbang med rgyug ste mnyan pa yin nam snyam/ /chos mthun ya rabs rnams ni ma bskul yang*/ /rtag tu dge ba'i phyogs la brtson bgyid na/ /chos smra'i ngag gi dge bskul phan yon can/ /dka' yang sgrub pa rang gi chos nyid yin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa sgrub pa'i grogs dang gnas dus ni/ de lta bu'i sa spyod bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos chos sbyin par du bsgrub pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi bka' lung rnams ji skad stsal ba bzhin du sngon gyi las dbang rkang mgyogs kyi pho nyas rings par bos te/ lugs gnyis kyi bgyi ba kun la dbang sgyur ba'i dpa' mdzangs 'phrul blon chen po rnams kyi nang nas bslab ston pa/ sngon bsags bsod nams kyi ri dbang brtan pos sa la spyod pa'i bstan srid lha dbang gi grong khyer mthon por 'degs la ngal ba med cing*/ chos dang srid kyi mkhyen dpyod nyi zla'i 'od snang ring por 'phro ba'i gnyer pa a srung gtso bor bskos/ las gnyer rnams kyi mgo 'dzin dang khur len gyi grogs ldan pa/ mkhyen dpyod kyi me long gtsang mar shes bya'i gzugs brnyan 'gog med du 'char ba'i drung yig tshe ring 'phel dang*/ phyag mdzod gu ru bkra shis gnyis la gnang nas/ de dag gi par bkram sdud sogs kyi grogs ldan pa brda dang yig rtsis la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo mig gsal ba par dpon gzungs skyabs bcas te/ zhu dag gi phyi mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dam pa mang po byon pa'i gdan sa/ skyor mda' bsam gling nas bka' 'bum shin tu dag pa cha gcig rga nas a gnyan dam pa'i thugs dam rten du bzhengs pa'i rje khu dbon gyi bka' 'bum gser dngul las grub cing*/

bzo rgyu khyad du 'phags pa'i chos chen glegs bam drug rong ston shes bya kun rig dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po ā nan+dadz+nyā na'i thugs dam rten gdan sa thar lam dgon nas dpe khungs thub cha gcig gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na sngar gong ma rnams kyis bzhengs pa dang*/ phyis chos rgyal rang nyid kyi thugs dam rten du gsar bzhengs mdzad pa bcas shin tu legs pa cha gnyis/ gzhan yang lcags ra bsam 'grub rtse dang*/ gling nas spyan drangs pa'i cha gnyis/ 'thor bu la mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i phyag dpe dngos ma 'ga' re dang bcas te/ bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs tshar drug tsam dang bstun nas/ dag byed gtso bor rang gi nye ba 'khor sgra dang snyan dngags sogs tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la byang chub pa/ dge slong tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ gzhan yang gsar rnying brda'i khyad la mkhas pa rmugs sangs pa sbyin pa rgya mtsho dang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan sogs bzhi tsam gyis zhus dag nan tan bgyis shing*/ rdo rje'i tshig gi dka' 'grel 'ga' zhig la phyi mo rnams mi mthun pa'i dogs gnas cung zad byung ba rnams kyang bka' dang bstan bcos gang yin gyi rtsa ba la gtugs te de dang mthun gang che'i dbang du btang*/ de dag tu'ang med pa'i 'dra min 'ga' re byung 'dug pa rnams ni bdag gis kyang dpyad pa'i grogs byas shing yid la nges pa rnams bcos/ ma nges pa rnams sor bzhag la rtags dang mchan bu yod par bgyis nas dpyad rung bzhag ste/ mdor na yid ches byar rung ba'i zhus dag nan chen bgyis/ 'phrul gyi yig gzugs la mkhas pa mang po'i nang nas bkrabs pa bcu drug dang*/ par brkos mkhas pa brgya lnga bcu tsam 'doms te/ de rnams la yon dbul rta nor/ ja dang ras/ du ba sogs gang mos byin pa nas kyi rtsis la/ zhus dag pa mi re la nyin re nas 'dong bcu gcig dbu lha'i brkos pa sku brnyan re la nas khal gcig dang zho gnyis/
